entities.summary: Joshua Mellody, professionally known as Zomboy, is an English dubstep music producer, songwriter, and DJ whose mascot is a zombie. Zomboy was a composers & musicians from Penzance (b. 1989-06-01, Penzance). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
